pr_title: tsdb: Support native histograms in snapshot on shutdown
pr_body:
This PR enables the abiity to store encoded histograms and float histograms in the snapshots.
This is needed when snapshot restoring is enabled during shutdowns.

Fixes #11262

issue_context.title: tsdb (histograms): Support native histograms in snapshot on shutdown
issue_context.body:
See http://ganeshvernekar.com/blog/prometheus-tsdb-snapshot-on-shutdown/ for context on the in-memory snapshot on shutdown.

The snapshot-on-shutdown feature itself is experimental and has to be activated with a feature flag. Therefore, this is only P2 because not having the support only means that you cannot switch on both feature flags at the same time.

Tentatively assigning to @codesome as he is the expert for the snapshot-on-shutdown feature.
